name: Education, Student Performance & Academic Analytics Playbook

benchmarks.attendance_correlation_threshold: r > 0.65 (Attendance strongly drives final grade outcomes; <75% attendance triggers dropout risk)
benchmarks.anomaly_tolerance: 1.0% - 3.0% (Academic anomalies reflect sudden grade drop-offs, administrative exam grading errors, or prodigy outliers)

profit_matrix.initiative: Tuition Revenue Protection via Week-4 Early Alert
profit_matrix.lever: Automate early-alert notifications for students missing 2+ early assignments or showing <80% attendance
profit_matrix.problem_solved: Students silently dropping out mid-semester, resulting in lost tuition revenue and diminished completion rankings
profit_matrix.financial_impact: Increases semester retention by 5% to 8%; preserves $180,000 to $450,000 in annual tuition income
profit_matrix.prescription: Mandate early intervention by Week 4: academic counselors must initiate direct contact with flagged disengaged students before drop-deadline dates. Keeping existing students enrolled is 5x more cost-effective than marketing to recruit replacements.

profit_matrix.lever: Deploy peer-assisted study sessions in foundational high-failure rate prerequisite courses
profit_matrix.problem_solved: Bottleneck prerequisite courses causing course failures, delayed graduation, and subsequent transfer departures
profit_matrix.financial_impact: Lowers course failure rates by 22%; improves 4-year on-time graduation rate by 14%
profit_matrix.prescription: Assign high-performing upperclassmen to lead structured weekly tutoring pods for lower-quartile students in gateway quantitative courses. Removing learning bottlenecks keeps students on track to complete their degree program.

profit_matrix.lever: Reallocate instructional budgets and section capacities toward high-demand, high-margin degree specializations
profit_matrix.problem_solved: Subsidizing chronically under-enrolled elective sections while waitlisting high-demand programs
profit_matrix.financial_impact: +10% to +16% expansion in net academic operational margin; optimizes faculty capacity
profit_matrix.prescription: Perform curriculum enrollment analysis: consolidate low-enrollment niche sections into alternating-semester schedules, and expand section seats in high-demand, high-tuition certificate and master's tracks.

knowledge_chunks.text: In academic and student performance analytics, course completion rates in traditional institutions benchmark between 78% and 88%. Attendance rates below 75% serve as the primary early warning indicator for student attrition. A healthy grade distribution exhibits a bell curve centered around 3.0 GPA with standard deviation near 0.6.

Academic anomalies (>2.0%) identify: (1) Sudden Severe Grade Drops (>2 standard deviations) reflecting personal crisis or disengagement, (2) Systematic Exam Grading Outliers indicating subjective grading bias across sections, or (3) Academic Honesty / Plagiarism Flags with irregular completion timestamps.

Consistent assignment submission velocity and attendance show the highest positive correlation with final assessment success. Midterm assessment scores correlate strongly (r > 0.75) with final outcome, making week-6 interventions the most cost-effective retention leverage point.

Priority Academic Dean & Faculty Plan: (1) Deploy early-alert automated interventions at Week 4 for students exhibiting consecutive missed submissions; (2) Standardize exam rubrics across teaching assistants to eliminate inter-section variance; (3) Implement peer tutoring cohorts for students in the lower quartile of core foundational prerequisite courses.
